cases.title: Validate Min Input Field Handling
cases.description: Test entering positive numbers, negative numbers, and non-numerical values into the 'min' input field (data-testid 'min') to ensure proper acceptance, storage, and default fallback to '1' for invalid inputs.

cases.title: Validate Max Input, Generation, and Copy Actions
cases.description: Test entering valid numerical values into the 'max' input field (data-testid='max') and non-numerical fallback to '100'. Verify random number generation via the 'generate-random-number-button', display in 'random-number-display' with a temporary scaling effect, and copying to clipboard via 'copy-to-clipboard-button' with text changing to 'Copied!'.

cases.title: Validate Initial State and Special Range Conditions
cases.description: Verify initial page load with title 'Random Number Generator' and default min/max values of '1' and '100'. Test scenarios where min equals max, min is greater than max, and non-numeric values are entered.

cases.title: Validate Scale Transformation and Copied Feedback Timeout
cases.description: Verify that generating a random number applies a temporary scale transformation on 'random-number-display' and that clicking the clipboard copy button changes the text to 'Copied!' for 2000 milliseconds before reverting. Also check handling when the random number evaluates to zero.

opinions.feedback: The proposed high-level test cases effectively cover all functional requirements, distinct scenarios (including edge cases such as min > max, min = max, negative numbers, zero, and non-numeric inputs), and necessary risk areas such as timing feedback and UI effects.
All cases and expected behaviors align correctly with the requirements and their cited IDs. No blockers found.

analysis.analysis: e2edev_bench_602-R-1: Testable behavior includes entering positive and negative numbers in 'min' (data-testid='min') and non-numerical inputs defaulting to '1' without altering internal state improperly. Boundaries include positive/negative/non-numeric values. Normal path: valid number entry. Abnormal path: non-numeric entry. e2edev_bench_602-R-2: Testable behavior includes entering valid numbers in 'max' (data-testid='max'), non-numeric defaulting to '100', displaying results in 'random-number-display', triggering generation via 'generate-random-number-button' with a scaling effect, and copying via 'copy-to-clipboard-button' changing text to 'Copied!'. Boundaries: valid vs invalid max values. Normal path: valid max input and generation/copying. Abnormal path: non-numeric max input. e2edev_bench_602-R-3: Testable behavior includes initial load with title 'Random Number Generator', default min/max values ('1' and '100'), equal min/max values, min > max range handling, and non-numeric defaults. Boundaries: min equals max, min greater than max. Normal path: standard range generation. Abnormal/Edge paths: min > max, equal min/max, non-numeric bounds. e2edev_bench_602-R-6: Testable behavior includes random number generation within min/max, scale transformation on 'random-number-display', copying to clipboard, button text changing to 'Copied!' for exactly 2000 ms before reverting, and handling zero as a generated random number. Boundaries: zero value edge case, 2000 ms timeout duration. Normal path: successful generation and copy feedback. Abnormal path: zero value handling.

coverage.feedback: The accepted test cases provide comprehensive coverage of all requirements (R-1, R-2, R-3, and R-6) without significant gaps. However, there is noticeable overlap and repetition across G-002, G-003, and G-004 regarding the random number generation, display, scaling effect, and copy-to-clipboard functionality. These overlapping assertions could be streamlined to avoid redundant testing of the same UI actions and elements across multiple test cases.
